verdict.rationale: Onboarding docs emphasize quick API key setup ('get your API key and make your first request in minutes'), implying an accessible entry point, and community evidence confirms a free tier exists. However, the same community evidence reveals the free tier's ToS explicitly prohibits use in AI inference, forcing developers prototyping AI/agent use cases to switch to a separate paid 'AI Inference' plan—undermining the prototyping story for a key developer segment.
